info.title: inventory-api
info.description: Extracted by reading FastAPI decorators directly (tier 4). Version from FastAPI(title=..., version="3.2.1") in app/main.py. NOTE: app/routers.py defines an APIRouter with prefix /inventory, but app/main.py never calls app.include_router — those routes are NOT mounted. They are listed here under x-unmounted for traceability because order-service's InventoryClient calls one of them.

post.description: Restocks only when reason_code is in RESTOCKABLE_REASONS = {"01", "02"} (01 파트너귀책, 02 시스템오류). Code comment: '03(고객 변심)은 배송이 시작된 뒤 취소되는 경우가 많아 복원 대상이 아니다.' Reads ORDER_DTL (an order-service table) directly, then updates stock_item.

404.description: 주문 상세 없음 — no ORDER_DTL row for ord_no

200.description: SELECT sku, available_qty, reserved_qty FROM stock_item. Not aggregated across warehouses — stock_item's PK is (sku, warehouse_cd), so this returns an arbitrary single warehouse row.

x-unmounted.note: Defined in app/routers.py (APIRouter prefix=/inventory, tags=[inventory]) but never registered on the FastAPI app. Calling them returns 404 in the running service.

reason_code.description: 취소 사유 코드; only 01 and 02 trigger a restock
